notes: Desktop unit; no built-in rack ears (rackUnits omitted) — optional RM19X adapter mounts it in 1U of a 19" rack. AES/EBU and MIDI I/O are delivered via a single D-Sub-9 "MIDI-AES" connector on the rear panel plus the included breakout cable (XLR for AES, 5-pin DIN for MIDI); listed here as their effective XLR/MIDI-DIN endpoints per RME's own spec table rather than the D-Sub itself, since D-Sub is not in the port list and the breakout provides the real end connectors. MADI optical ports use FDDI-duplex SC fiber connectors (62.5/125 and 50/125 multimode); mapped to the closest available id "fiber-lc" since SC is not in the connector list. MADI is a proprietary AES10 multichannel format, not SDI, so no bandwidth "grade" applies to the MADI BNC/optical ports (grade field correctly omitted). Power inlet is a locking-type DC barrel connector (proprietary lock collar) fed by an internal/external 100-240V AC switching supply (24W); mapped to dc-barrel, closest match, note the locking mechanism differs from a standard barrel jack. The "REMOTE" rear port (for the optional ARC USB remote, sold separately) is a USB-A-style host jack per product photos; mapped to usb-a bidirectional with no grade stated (ARC USB itself is USB 1.1, but the host jack spec is not stated by RME) — medium-confidence detail only, does not affect overall confidence since it is a minor/optional accessory port. Front-panel Mic/Line 1-2 are Neutrik combo jacks: primary XLR, accepts 6.3mm TRS. Headphone/Phones jack on front panel is a 6.3mm TRS jack wired unbalanced (physical connector is still TRS, so mapped to trs-6.35) and doubles as a second balanced-impedance line output per RME's manual ("DA, Phones 3/4... As DA Line Out, but... Output: 6.3mm TRS jack, unbalanced"). USB port is USB-B receptacle, USB 3.0 (5 Gbps) with automatic fallback to USB 2.0 (usb-2.0) — graded as usb-5g reflecting the primary/rated speed. All core specs (analog I/O, MADI, AES, word clock, MIDI, USB, power) were confirmed directly from RME's own official User's Guide PDF (Chapter 38 "Technical Specifications" and Chapter 5 "Connectors" with rear/front panel photos), the highest-authority source available.
